title: Design System: Bitrate for Artists — Pencil

body.purpose: The interface family observed in the Pencil source; this does not redefine final brand typography.

label.purpose: Action text inherited from the shared component masters.

narrative.overview: A calm production workspace with neutral structure, recognizable purple actions, explicit status, and a clear next step. Artwork and music-production imagery carry personality while the interface helps the artist manage work without competing with the music. This metadata describes static designs; the .pen file remains the source of truth.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral surfaces and disciplined purple actions.
A coherent type hierarchy and moderate information density.
Status includes text; absent data is stated explicitly.
Mobile preserves content and the next action.

rules.name: The Status Rule
rules.body: Communicate state through a label and, when useful, an icon. Color reinforces the message but never carries it alone.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Static designs define visual intent. Transitions, hover, focus, disabled, keyboard, loading, responsive behavior, and motion require separate runtime verification.

dos: Reuse variables, masters, and original brand assets from the .pen source.
Preserve status meaning, content, and the next action during adaptation.
Label absent data and illustrative content explicitly.
donts: Do not replace the neutral workspace with an undifferentiated neon scene.
Do not present static designs, demo numbers, or planned capabilities as shipped product.
Do not copy literal token values between dark, light, and dim themes.
